units.translation: Hesychius: ξυναυλίαν [a joint flute-playing] — every double matter, the flute-playing performed by two; for whenever two play the flute, it is called ξυναυλία [joint flute-playing].
Scholium: the disaster of the battle became ill-omened for them; they came together into battle for evil.
Or is this ill-omened joint flute-playing of the spear?
